cards.title: Thermal model vs reference
cards.headline: Max abs. error 0.00 C over 600 cases
cards.baseline: linerate IEEE 738; CIGRE TB 601 Ex. B ampacity 1505 A vs published 1504 A
cards.one_liner: Our heat-balance code matches the reference library and the published worked examples. That shows correct implementation, not real-world accuracy.

cards.title: Weather inputs vs ground stations
cards.headline: Test windy-hour gust bias -3.7 m/s (RMSE 5.9)
cards.baseline: All test hours: bias +2.1 m/s; temperature RMSE 2.1 C
cards.one_liner: Reanalysis gusts are close on ordinary hours but miss the strongest Santa Ana gusts; the training events did not contain enough of them to correct this.

cards.title: Demand model vs actual (H2 heat wave)
cards.headline: Peak within 10.4% (SCE) / 8.0% (LDWP); MAPE 9.3% / 7.2%
cards.baseline: Same hour last week: MAPE 13.8% / 19.3%, peak error 2.7% / 5.2%
cards.one_liner: Weather-only demand tracks the heat wave better hour by hour than persistence, but underpredicts the record peak by more than persistence does.

cards.title: Grid stress vs actual outages (event replay)
cards.headline: E1 Spearman 0.13, lead -10 h; E3 Spearman 0.78, lead -49 h
cards.baseline: Calm test week C3: alarm on 10.7% of hours
cards.one_liner: The risk index co-moves with outages most in E3 (Spearman 0.78). In every test wind event (E1, E3) outages began rising before our alarm, so this is not yet an early warning.

cards.title: Discrimination over 2022-2024
cards.headline: Risk index AUC 0.62
cards.one_liner: As a general predictor of the worst outage hours, our fire-weather index does NOT beat gust alone: many outage peaks come from wet winter storms that are windy but not fire weather.

cards.title: Ignition hindcast
cards.headline: Woolsey Fire top 1%; Eaton Fire top 10%; Hurst Fire top 5%
cards.baseline: Gust-only: Woolsey Fire top 4%; Eaton Fire top 1%; Hurst Fire top 29%; random: top 50%
cards.one_liner: The line nearest each test ignition ranked in the top 10% of 829 lines at ignition time; 3 cases is far too few for a rate.

cards.title: De-energization vs SCE PSPS (E3, county level)
cards.headline: County overlap 3/4 (Jaccard 0.75)
cards.baseline: No meaningful baseline at county level
cards.one_liner: Our de-energization counties match most of SCE's at county level, which is too coarse to show we would have chosen the same circuits.

cards.title: Red Flag consistency
cards.headline: 95% of high-risk line-hours inside a Red Flag Warning
cards.baseline: 28% of Red Flag zone-hours contain a high-risk line
cards.one_liner: When we flag a line, NWS forecasters had almost always flagged that area too; we flag far less than they do (conservative).
